### Auto-generated by the `processRovquantOutput` function from the `rovquantR` package on `r Sys.Date()`

```{r, setup, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
years <- params$years
seasons <- params$seasons
species <- params$species
working.dir <- params$working.dir
date <- params$date
sampling.months <- params$sampling.months

##-- Species
if(sum(grep("bear", species, ignore.case = T))>0|sum(grep("bjorn", species, ignore.case = T))>0){
  engSpecies <- "bear"
  engSpeciess <- "bears"
  SPECIES <- "Brown bear"
  species <- "brown bear"
  latSpecies <- "Ursus arctos"
} else {
  if(sum(grep("wolf", species, ignore.case = T))>0|sum(grep("ulv", species, ignore.case = T))>0){
    engSpecies <- "wolf"
    engSpeciess <- "wolves"
    SPECIES <- "Wolf"
    species <- "gray wolf"
    latSpecies <- "Canis lupus"
  } else {
    if(sum(grep("wolverine", species, ignore.case = T))>0|sum(grep("jerv", species, ignore.case = T))>0){
      engSpecies <- species <- "wolverine"
      engSpeciess <- "wolverines"
      SPECIES <- "Wolverine"
      latSpecies <- "Gulo gulo"
    } else {
      engSpecies <- engSpeciess <- SPECIES <- latSpecies <- species 
    }}}


##-- Sampling months
if(is.null(sampling.months)) {
  if (engSpecies == "bear") {
    sampling.months <- list(4:11)
  } else {
    if (engSpecies == "wolf") {
      sampling.months <- list(c(10:12),c(1:3))
    } else {
      if (engSpecies == "wolverine") {
        sampling.months <- list(c(10:12),c(1:4))
      } else {
        stop("No default setting available for the monitoring period of this species. \n You must specify the monitoring season months through the 'sampling.months' argument.")
      }
    }
  }
}

months = c("January","February","March","April","May","June",
           "July","August","September","October","November","December")

cMonths <- unlist(sampling.months)
firstMonth <- months[cMonths[1]]
lastMonth <- months[cMonths[length(cMonths)]]

##-- load libraries
library(kableExtra)
library(rovquantR)
```

```{r, data, echo = FALSE}
##-- Load pre-processed habitat shapefiles
data(COUNTRIESWaterHumans, envir = environment()) 
COUNTRIES <- COUNTRIESWaterHumans[COUNTRIESWaterHumans$ISO %in% c("SWE","NOR"), ] %>%

##-- Get extraction date
fileList <- list.files(file.path(working.dir, "data")) 
fileName <- fileList[grep(paste0("CleanData_",engSpecies,"_"), fileList)]
extractDate <- sub("^.*_(.*)\\.RData$", "\\1",  fileName)

##-- Load detectors
load(file.path( working.dir, "data", paste0("Detectors_", engSpecies, "_", date, ".RData")))

##-- Load filtered data
load(file.path( working.dir, "data", paste0("FilteredData_", engSpecies, "_", date, ".RData")))

##-- Load results tables
N_LastYear <- read.csv(file.path( working.dir, "tables/N_LastYearPerSex_region_SCR.csv"), check.names = F, row.names = 1)

##-- Extract abundances for the last year
CI <- as.numeric(strsplit(sub('.*\\((.*)\\).*', '\\1', N_LastYear["Total","Total"]), "-")[[1]])
CI_F <- as.numeric(strsplit(sub('.*\\((.*)\\).*', '\\1', N_LastYear["Total","Females"]), "-")[[1]])
CI_M <- as.numeric(strsplit(sub('.*\\((.*)\\).*', '\\1', N_LastYear["Total","Males"]), "-")[[1]])
```

# Introduction

Non-invasive genetic sampling (NGS) and dead recoveries are a centerpiece of national and regional large carnivore monitoring in Norway and Sweden. The Scandinavian `r species` (*`r latSpecies`*) population is monitored annually using non-invasive genetic sampling (NGS) and recovery of dead individuals ([rovbase.no](https://www.rovbase.no/), [rovbase.se](https://www.rovbase.se/)).

Project [RovQuant](https://www.nmbu.no/en/research/projects/rovquant), from the Norwegian University of Life Sciences (NMBU), has been developing custom Open-Population Spatial Capture-Recapture (OPSCR) methods [@bischof2019rovquant; @bischof2020estimating] to analyse this database and produce estimates of the population status and dynamics for the brown bear (*Ursus arctos*), wolf (*Canis lupus*), and wolverine (*Gulo gulo*).

RovQuant has published annual reports summarizing these analyses for wolverines and wolves since 2019 [@bischof2019wolf; @bischof2019rovquant; @bischof2020estimating; @flagstad2021; @milleret2021wolf; @milleret2021wolverine; @milleret2022wolf; @milleret2022wolverine; @milleret2023wolf; @milleret2023wolverine; @milleret2024wolf] and for brown bears in Norway since 2022 [@dupontNorBear2021; @dupontNorBear2022; @dupontNorBear2023; @dupontNorBear2024]. 

RovQuant has also continuously worked on improving the performance of the OPSCR models During these and other analyses [@milleret2018pab; @milleret2019local; @bischof2020consequences; @dupont2021deadreco; @turek2021efficient; @dey2022; @moqanaki2021].

This document refers to the output processing and presents the results of the SCR analysis of the **`r species`** data collected during the monitoring period **`r seasons`**.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Results

## Non-invasive genetic samples and dead recoveries

```{r, ngs data, echo = FALSE, collapse = TRUE}
ngs <- data.alive$data.sp[data.alive$data.sp$Year == years, ]

##-- Number of NGS samples collected per sex 
numDet_sex <- table(ngs$Sex)
if(length(dim(numDet_sexYear)) > 1){
  numDet_sex <- c(numDet_sex,sum(numDet_sex))
  names(numDet_sex) <- c("female","male","Total")
}

##-- Number of NGS samples collected per country
percCountry <- table(ngs$Country_sample)
percCountry <- round(percCountry[1]/sum(percCountry)*100)

##-- Number of individuals detected per sex and per year
numId_sex <- apply(table(ngs$Id,ngs$Sex) > 0, 2, sum)
if(length(dim(numId_sex)) > 1){
  numId_sex <- c(numId_sex, sum(numId_sex))
  names(numId_sex) <- c("female","male","Total")
}
```

A total of `r numDet_sex["Total"]` (`r numDet_sex["female"]` female; `r numDet_sex["male"]` male) genotyped `r species` genetic samples were included in the analysis, of which `r percCountry`% originated from Norway. These samples were associated with `r numId_sex["Total"]` (`r numId_sex["female"]` female; `r numId_sexYear["male"]` male) individuals. Individuals with unknown sex were not included in this analysis.

```{r, Fig1, include = TRUE, fig.align = "center", fig.cap = paste0("Figure 1: Spatial distribution of ", engSpecies, " non-invasive genetic samples (NGS, yellow crosses) collected during the monitoring period ", seasons, " and included in the SCR analysis. We included only samples collected within the study area during the primary monitoring period."), echo = FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(working.dir, "figures/NGS_SCR_maps.png"))
```

## Density and abundance

We estimated that, within its primary range (`r round(detectors$n.detectors*(detectors$resolution/1000)^2)` $km^{2}$), the `r engSpecies` population was likely (95% credible interval) made up of between `r CI[1]` and `r CI[2]` individuals (95% credible interval) in `r seasons`, with between `r CI_F[1]` and `r CI_F[2]` females and between `r CI_M[1]` and `r CI_M[2]` males.

```{r, Tab1, echo = FALSE, collapse = TRUE}

whichBold <- which(rownames(N_LastYear) %in% c("Total","Sweden","Norway"))
whichInd0 <- which(rownames(N_LastYear) %in% c("Total"))
whichInd1 <- which(rownames(N_LastYear) %in% c("Sweden","Norway"))
whichInd2 <- c( grep("Region",rownames(N_LastYear)), which(rownames(N_LastYear) %in% c("Nordre","Söndre","Midtre")))
whichInd3 <- which(!1:nrow(N_LastYear) %in% c(whichInd0,whichInd1,whichInd2))
  
N_LastYear %>%
  kable( format = "html",
         align = "ccc",
         table.attr = "style='width:80%;'",
         caption = paste0("Table 1. ", SPECIES, " population size estimates in ", seasons," within the study area by sex and large carnivore management region. Only management units that are within or that intersect the study area are included in the table. Readers should focus on the 95% credible interval provided in parentheses as these - unlike mean values - convey uncertainty inherent in abundance estimates. Numbers are based on estimated AC locations. Combined female-male estimates were obtained by joining sex-specific posterior distributions. Rounding may result in small deviations between total estimates and the sum of the estimates for constituent regions.")) %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = T, html_font = "Cambria") %>%
  row_spec(row = c(0,whichBold), bold = T) %>%
  add_indent(positions = whichInd1, level_of_indent = 1)  %>%
  add_indent(positions = whichInd2, level_of_indent = 2)  %>%
  add_indent(positions = whichInd3, level_of_indent = 3)

```

```{r, Fig2, include = TRUE, fig.align = "center", fig.cap = paste0("Figure 2: ", species, " density in Scandinavia in ", seasons, " based on individual utilization distributions throughout the study area (white background). This map is available as a geo-referenced raster in the 'raster' folder of the working directory"), echo = FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(working.dir, "figures/UD_Density_SCR_LastYear.png"))
```



## Detection probability

```{r, propDetected1, echo = FALSE, collapse = TRUE}

propDet <- read.csv(file.path( working.dir, "tables/PropDetected_SCR.csv"), check.names = F, row.names = 1)

##-- Extract proportion detected for the last year
CI <- as.numeric(strsplit(sub('.*\\((.*)\\).*', '\\1', propDet["Total",1]), "-")[[1]])
```

A large proportion of the population is detected during annual large carnivore monitoring. Specifically, during the monitoring period `r seasons`, between `r round(CI[1]*100)`% and `r round(CI[2]*100)`% of the population were detected in the study area during non-invasive genetic sampling. 

```{r, Tab2, echo = FALSE, collapse = TRUE}
propDet %>%
  kable( format = "html",
         escape = F,
         align = "c",
         caption = paste0("Table 2. Proportion of individuals detected in the population. Estimates are based on activity center locations estimated by the spatial capture-recapture (SCR) model. Credible intervals (95%) are shown in parentheses.")) %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = F, html_font = "Cambria") %>%
  kable_styling(font_size = 10) %>%
  row_spec(row = 0, bold = T) %>%
  column_spec(column = 1, bold = T) 
```
